title: Reviews from every kind of trip.
subtitle: Travelers across business trips, family weeks and city hops, sharing what worked and what didn't.
note: Sample reviews shown for layout — replace with your own verified customer reviews before launch.

items.name: Amara N.
items.text: Bought a 10GB plan the morning of my flight, scanned the QR at the gate, and it connected on landing. Used it everywhere from city subways to a quiet countryside inn.

items.name: Leo P.
items.text: Boarding pass on my phone, ride from arrivals, hotel check-in — all on the eSIM before I'd cleared customs.

items.name: Sofia R.
items.text: Took a minute to figure out which plan size fit a four-day trip, but once it activated it just worked through Maps and calls back to the office.

items.name: Diego B.
items.text: I'm in and out of a few cities most months, so I just buy a fresh data plan on the way to the airport. Faster than dealing with kiosks.

items.name: Hiroko T.
items.text: Two kids, one ferry with no Wi-Fi, and a lot of 'can I see the map again?'. The data plan kept us navigating and messaging the whole week.

items.name: Ravi K.
items.text: Hopping between cities, the data held up in places I didn't expect signal. Booking rides, calling guesthouses, sending photos home — none of it was a fight.

items.name: Elena M.
items.text: Grabbed a fresh plan for each stop as I went. Setup was quick every time, so I barely thought about data.

items.name: Owen S.
items.text: Several ports in ten days. The eSIM handled most of them well, and I was back online by the time we docked. Did the job.
